Hint: fewest online orders refer to MIN(Quantity);
sql: SELECT p.Class, p.ProductLine, p.ListPrice FROM Product p JOIN SalesOrderDetail sod ON sod.ProductID = p.ProductID JOIN SalesOrderHeader soh ON soh.SalesOrderID = sod.SalesOrderID WHERE soh.OnlineOrderFlag = 1 ORDER BY sod.OrderQty ASC LIMIT 1
